content_sections.heading: ESIC PMU ICT Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The 25 vacancies are spread across leadership, engineering, and specialist roles within four broad functions: IT Operations & Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Vendor/Procurement & Project Management, and Applications/Database/Networking.

content_sections.heading: ESIC PMU ICT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026 is position-specific: leadership roles require significantly more experience than engineer-level roles. Candidates may apply for more than one post but must submit a separate application for each. Across all 25 posts, the essential educational qualification is a Bachelor's or Postgraduate degree in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Electronics & Communication/other engineering stream or MCA from a recognized university, with two exceptions: the Project Director (PMU Head) additionally requires an MBA in IT/Project Management, and several posts note that relevant OEM or domain certifications (e.g., in Windows/Linux administration, virtualization, ISO 27001, SIEM/XDR/NAC, networking, or database/SAS platforms) are preferred or an added advantage. Across most posts, preference is given to candidates with prior Government/PSU experience, and to those who have worked in high-availability production environments (typically 99.5% or higher SLA) in sectors such as BFSI, telecom, or other large enterprises.

rows.minimum_experience: 20 years in large-scale IT/e-Governance/enterprise ICT, including 8 years managing mission-critical systems
12 years in enterprise IT operations, including 5 years as IT Operations Lead
6 years each in the respective OS administration
12 years in cyber security operations and security audits
6 years each in the respective security platforms/operations
12 years in IT project/vendor management and procurement, including 5 years as lead
6 years each in the respective function
12 years in enterprise IT infrastructure, including 5 years as Infrastructure Lead
6 years in IT infrastructure planning and operations
6 years each in the respective database function
12 years in enterprise application support, including 5 years as lead
6 years each in the respective technology stack
12 years in enterprise networking/data centre operations, including 5 years as lead

rows.position: Networking Engineer (all three streams) / Network Administrator
rows.minimum_experience: 6 years each in the respective networking function

content_sections.heading: ESIC PMU ICT Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age of a candidate as on the closing date of application must not be less than 18 years and must not exceed 62 years. The Corporation has clarified separately that the contract period itself will not extend beyond the candidate turning 65 years, whichever is earlier. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: ESIC PMU ICT Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration ranging from ₹80,000 to ₹3,30,000 depending on the position, as detailed in the vacancy table above. This remuneration is inclusive of all applicable taxes, and no other facility or allowance will be paid. Remuneration for retired government servants engaged under this scheme will follow applicable Government of India guidelines.

content_sections.heading: ESIC PMU ICT Selection Process
content_sections.text: Engagement will be made on the recommendation of a duly constituted Selection Committee approved by the Competent Authority/Director General, ESIC. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be called for an interview based on the information furnished in the application form; ESIC has clarified that mere submission of an application does not confer any right to be called for interview, and that detailed verification of credentials is not undertaken before the interview stage, making candidature provisional until document verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Despite the term "apply online" being a common search pattern, ESIC has specified that applications for this recruitment must be sent only by email to [email protected] , with all documents, testimonials, and certificates attached in PDF format. Applications sent by post, by hand, or through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Applications received after the closing date will also not be entertained. Candidates applying for more than one post must send a separate application for each post.

content_sections.heading: ESIC PMU ICT Terms of Engagement (Key Points)
content_sections.text: Engagement is purely contractual and does not create any employer-employee relationship or any claim to regular appointment/absorption in ESIC. The engagement is full-time; professionals cannot take up any other assignment during the contract period. ESIC may terminate the engagement at any time without providing reasons, and either side may end the contract with 15 days' written notice (waivable for misconduct-based termination, which takes immediate effect). Leave is admissible at 1.5 days per completed month, without carry-forward beyond the calendar year. Reservation is applicable as per Government of India instructions (specific category-wise breakup is Not Specified in this notification).

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is ESIC's notification for engaging 25 professionals in the Project Management Unit of its ICT Division on a full-time, fixed-term contractual basis, as per advertisement File No. A-12016/23/2025-E-III dated 09.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies spread across 25 distinct positions, from Project Director (PMU Head) to Network Administrator Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement (dated 09.09.2026); candidates should confirm the exact closing date on www.esic.gov.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Most posts require a Bachelor's or Postgraduate degree in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Electronics & Communication/other engineering stream or MCA; the Project Director post additionally requires an MBA in IT/Project Management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and not more than 62 years old as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email only, in the prescribed format with PDF attachments, to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC PMU ICT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview conducted on the recommendation of a Selection Committee approved by the Director General, ESIC, based on the eligibility details furnished in the application.
